```{r}
# Install required packages if not already installed
#install.packages(c("sf", "rnaturalearth", "rnaturalearthdata", "ggplot2"))

library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(ggplot2)
library(maps)
library(cowplot)
library(sp)
library(raster)
library(scales)
library(geodata)
library(tidyterra)
library(ggspatial)
library(terra)
library(plotly)
library(readxl)
library(wesanderson) 

raster_obj <- rast("Annual_NLCD_LndCov_2020_CU_C1V1/Annual_NLCD_LndCov_2020_CU_C1V1.tif")

# Load the US map
us <- ne_states(country = "United States of America", returnclass = "sf")

# Keep only the lower 48 states
lower48 <- us[!us$name %in% c("Alaska", "Hawaii", "Puerto Rico"), ]

# Load rivers (scale = large)
rivers <- ne_download(scale = "large", type = "rivers_lake_centerlines", category = "physical", returnclass = "sf")

# Crop rivers to lower 48 bounding box
bbox <- st_bbox(lower48)
rivers <- st_crop(rivers, bbox)

# Filter rivers by approximate names (case insensitive)
major_rivers <- c("Mississippi", "Missouri", "Ohio", "Arkansas", "Illinois", "Tennessee")
rivers_major <- rivers[grepl(paste(major_rivers, collapse="|"), rivers$name, ignore.case = TRUE), ]


#get elevation data
elevation_data <- elevation_30s(country="USA", path=tempdir() )

dem = crop(elevation_data, bbox, snap= 'out')
## crop and mask
r1 <- crop(dem, extent(bbox))
# Reproject raster to match lower48 if needed
r1 <- project(r1, crs(lower48))

# Mask raster outside Lower 48 polygon
r1_masked <- mask(r1, vect(lower48))


points <- read_excel("metadata.xlsx", sheet = "metadata_V3")

p1 <- vect(points, geom = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"), crs = "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84")

# 3️⃣ Convert to sf
points_sf <- st_as_sf(p1)  
# points_sf now keeps all columns from `points` automatically

colors_points <- c("black", "black")
colors_rivers <- c("#ADC491","#2B99B1", "#2CBA91","#EACB2B", "#36A4AB","#E78F0A","#D55E00")

points_colors <- setNames(
  rep(colors_points, length.out = length(unique(points_sf$Mississippi_River_Label))),
  unique(points_sf$Mississippi_River_Label)
)

rivers_colors <- setNames(
  rep(colors_rivers, length.out = length(unique(rivers_major$name))),
  unique(rivers_major$name)
)

# Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = r1_masked, aes(fill = USA_elv_msk)) +
  geom_sf(data = rivers_major, aes(color = name), size = 1) +
  geom_sf(data = points_sf, aes(color = as.factor(Mississippi_River_Label)), size = 2) +  # Add points
  #labs(title = "Mississippi River and Main Tributaries (Lower 48 States)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_gradient(high = "lightgrey", low = "#555",  na.value='transparent')+
  scale_color_manual(values = c(points_colors, rivers_colors))+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
    annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.5) +
  annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "bl",
    pad_x = unit(0, "in"),
    pad_y = unit(0.3, "in"),
    style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering)
```
